translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Grand Tutor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was advanced to Grand Preceptor and took charge of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 丁未，領軍將軍柳元景加驃騎將軍，尚書令建平王宏加中書監、衞將軍，撫軍將軍、江州刺史東海王褘進號平南將軍。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Colonel of the Garrison Liu Yuanjing was given the additional title Rapid Tiger General-in-Chief; the Director of the Imperial Secretariat Prince of Jianping Hong was given the additional posts of Supervisor of the Secretariat and General of the Guard; the General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiang Prince of Donghai Yi was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Colonel of the Garrison Liu Yuanjing was given the additional title Rapid Tiger General-in-Chief; Director of the Imperial Secretariat Prince of Jianping Hong was given the additional posts of Supervisor of the Secretariat and General of the Guard; General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Jiang Prince of Donghai Yi was advanced to General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸丑，淮南太守袁景有罪棄市。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day guichou, the Administrator of Huainan Yuan Jing, having committed a crime, was executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the eleventh month, Administrator of Huainan Yuan Jing, having committed a crime, was executed in the marketplace.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，以侍中孔靈符為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day bingwu, the Palace Attendant Kong Lingfu was made Inspector of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the twelfth month, Palace Attendant Kong Lingfu was made Inspector of Ying.

sentences.zh: 大明元年春正月辛亥朔，改元，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of spring in the first year of Daming, xinhai, the era name was changed and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month of Daming, xinhai, the era name was changed and a general amnesty proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 賜高年孤疾粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: The elderly, the orphaned, and the sick were each given grain and cloth in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The elderly, orphans, and sick were each given grain and cloth in differing amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚午，護軍將軍劉延孫遷職，右衞將軍湘東王彧為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the Colonel of the Guard Liu Yansun was transferred; the General of the Right Guard Prince of Xiangdong Yu was made Colonel of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Colonel of the Guard Liu Yansun was transferred; General of the Right Guard Prince of Xiangdong Yu was made Colonel of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 京邑雨水，辛未，遣使檢行，賜以樵米。

translations.literal: Rain fell in the capital region; on the day xinwei, envoys were sent to inspect the damage and firewood and grain were bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: Rain fell in the capital region; on xinwei envoys were sent to inspect the damage and firewood and grain were bestowed.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，復親民職公田。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, the public fields of the officials who personally governed the people were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the public fields of officials who personally governed the people were restored.

sentences.zh: 索虜寇兗州。

translations.literal: The Rong enemy raided Yan province.
translations.idiomatic: The Rong enemy raided Yan province.

sentences.zh: 三月壬戌，制大臣加班劍者，不得入宮城門。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renxu, it was ordained that great ministers who had been granted the ceremonial sword at court might not enter the inner gates of the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the third month, it was ordained that great ministers granted the ceremonial sword at court might not enter the inner gates of the palace.

sentences.zh: 梁州獠求內屬，立懷漢郡。

translations.literal: The Liao of Liangzhou sought to submit and be incorporated; the Commandery Who Cherishes the Han was established.
translations.idiomatic: The Liao of Liangzhou sought to submit and be incorporated; the Commandery Who Cherishes the Han was established.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，京邑疾疫，丙申，遣使按行，賜給醫藥。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, plague struck the capital; on the day bingshen, envoys were sent to inspect the districts and medicine was bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer plague struck the capital; on bingshen envoys were sent to inspect the districts and medicine was bestowed.

sentences.zh: 死而無收斂者，官為斂埋。

translations.literal: Those who died without anyone to gather and bury them—the government would gather and bury them.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died with no one to bury them were gathered and buried by the government.

sentences.zh: 庚子，省湘州宋建郡并臨賀。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, the Songjian Commandery of Xiang province was abolished and merged into Linhe.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi the Songjian Commandery of Xiang province was abolished and merged into Linhe.

sentences.zh: 五月，吳興、義興大水，民饑。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Wu Xing and Yixing suffered great floods and the people were famished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Wu Xing and Yixing suffered great floods and the people went hungry.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，遣使開倉賑卹。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, envoys were sent to open the granaries and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao envoys were sent to open the granaries and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以左衞將軍沈曇慶為徐州刺史，輔國將軍梁瑾葱為河州刺史、宕昌王。

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the General of the Left Guard Shen Tanqing was made Inspector of Xu; the Assisting State General Liang Jincong was made Inspector of He and Prince of Dangchang.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai General of the Left Guard Shen Tanqing was made Inspector of Xu; Assisting State General Liang Jincong was made Inspector of He and Prince of Dangchang.

sentences.zh: 六月己卯，以前太子步兵校尉劉祗子歆繼南豐王朗。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jimao, the former Colonel of Footsoldiers of the Crown Prince Liu Zhizi Xin succeeded as Prince of Nanfeng Lang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the sixth month, the former Colonel of Footsoldiers of the Crown Prince Liu Zhizi Xin succeeded as Prince of Nanfeng Lang.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以長水校尉山陽王休祐為東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the Colonel of the Long River Prince of Shanyang Xiuyou was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Colonel of the Long River Prince of Shanyang Xiuyou was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，休祐改為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, Xiuyou was changed to Inspector of Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Xiuyou was changed to Inspector of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 以丹陽尹顏竣為東揚州刺史。

translations.literal: The Administrator of Danyang Yan Jun was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.
translations.idiomatic: Administrator of Danyang Yan Jun was made Inspector of Eastern Yang.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，土斷雍州諸僑郡縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinwei, the emigrant commanderies and counties of Yong province were subjected to land registration in their actual districts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the seventh month of autumn, the emigrant commanderies and counties of Yong province were subjected to land registration in their actual districts.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，於兗州立陽平郡。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuxu, the Yangping Commandery was established in Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu in the eighth month, the Yangping Commandery was established in Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，司空、南徐州刺史竟陵王誕改為南兗州刺史，太子詹事劉延孫為鎮軍將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Jingling Dan was changed to Inspector of Southern Yan; the Steward of the Heir Apparent Liu Yansun was made General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Xu Prince of Jingling Dan was changed to Inspector of Southern Yan; Steward of the Heir Apparent Liu Yansun was made General Who Guards the Army and Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丙申，詔曰：「旒纊之道，有孚於結繩，日昃之勤，已切於姬后。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day bingshen, an edict was issued: The way of the royal cap and fringe tassels had sincerity even in the age of knotted cords; the diligence of working until sunset already touched the consort of Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the tenth month of winter, an edict declared: The way of the royal cap and fringe tassels had sincerity even in the age of knotted cords; the diligence of working until sunset already touched the consort of Ji.

sentences.zh: 況世弊教淺，歲月澆季。

translations.literal: How much more when the age is decadent and teaching shallow, and the years are a season of erosion!
translations.idiomatic: How much more when the age is decadent and teaching shallow, and the years are a season of erosion!

sentences.zh: 朕雖勠力宇內，未明求衣，而識狹前王，務廣昔代，永言菲德，其愧良深。

translations.literal: Though I exert my strength within the realm, I have not yet made clear my seeking of garments; yet my understanding is narrower than that of former kings, and my tasks broader than those of past ages—ever speaking of meager virtue, the shame is truly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Though I exert my strength within the realm, I have not yet made clear my seeking of garments; yet my understanding is narrower than that of former kings, and my tasks broader than those of past ages—ever speaking of meager virtue, the shame is truly deep.

sentences.zh: 朝咨野怨，自達者寡，惠民利公，所昧實眾。

translations.literal: In court I consult, in the countryside I heed resentment—those who reach me are few; to benefit the people and serve the public—what I do not understand is indeed many.
translations.idiomatic: In court I consult, in the countryside I heed resentment—those who reach me are few; to benefit the people and serve the public—what I do not understand is indeed many.

sentences.zh: 自今百辟庶尹，下民賤隸，有懷誠抱志，擁鬱衡閭，失理負謗，未聞朝聽者，皆聽躬自申奏，小大以聞。

translations.literal: From now on, among the hundred offices and myriad functionaries, down to the humble and base, all who harbor sincere intent and embrace ambition, who are pent up and distressed at their gate and lane, who have lost reason and bear slander yet have not been heard at court—let them all be permitted to present petitions in person, great and small alike to be reported.
translations.idiomatic: From now on, among the hundred offices and myriad functionaries, down to the humble and base, all who harbor sincere intent, who are pent up at their gate and lane, who have lost reason and bear slander yet have not been heard at court—let them all present petitions in person, great and small alike to be reported.

sentences.zh: 朕因聽政之日，親對覽焉。

translations.literal: On the days when I hear government affairs, I shall personally examine them.」
translations.idiomatic: On the days when I hear government affairs, I shall personally examine them.」

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，以百濟王餘慶為鎮東大將軍。

translations.literal: 」On the day jiachen, the king of Baekje Yu Qing was made General Who Guards the East.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiachen the king of Baekje Yu Qing was made General Who Guards the East.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，順陽王休範改封桂陽王。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day dinghai, Prince of Shunyang Xiufan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Guiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the twelfth month, Prince of Shunyang Xiufan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Guiyang.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the second year, on the day xinhai, the imperial carriage sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the first month of the second year, the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.

sentences.zh: 壬子，詔曰：「去歲東土多經水災。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, an edict was issued: Last year the eastern regions suffered many floods.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi an edict declared: Last year the eastern regions suffered many floods.

sentences.zh: 春務已及，宜加優課。

translations.literal: Spring tasks have already arrived; favorable levies should be increased.
translations.idiomatic: Spring tasks have already arrived; favorable levies should be increased.

sentences.zh: 糧種所須，以時貸給。

translations.literal: Whatever seed grain is needed shall be loaned in season.」
translations.idiomatic: Whatever seed grain is needed shall be loaned in season.」

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，復郡縣田秩，并九親祿俸。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the field salaries of commanderies and counties were restored, together with the stipends of the nine degrees of kin.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the field salaries of commanderies and counties were restored, together with the stipends of the nine degrees of kin.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔曰：「先帝靈命初興，龍飛西楚，歲紀浸遠，感往纏心。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, an edict was issued: When the late emperor first received the Mandate, he rose like a dragon in western Chu; the years have gradually grown distant, and remembrance of the past binds the heart.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu an edict declared: When the late emperor first received the Mandate, he rose like a dragon in western Chu; the years have gradually grown distant, and remembrance of the past binds the heart.

sentences.zh: 奉迎文武，情深常隸，思弘殊澤，以申永懷。

translations.literal: Those civil and military officials who welcomed him—the depth of feeling is that of long service; I wish to extend a special grace to declare everlasting regard.
translations.idiomatic: Those civil and military officials who welcomed him—the depth of feeling is that of long service; I wish to extend a special grace to declare everlasting regard.

sentences.zh: 吏身可賜爵一級，軍戶免為平民。」

translations.literal: Clerical personnel may be granted one rank of nobility; military households may be freed to become civilians.」
translations.idiomatic: Clerical personnel may be granted one rank of nobility; military households may be freed to become civilians.」

sentences.zh: 二月丙子，詔曰：「政道未著，俗弊尚深，豪侈兼并，貧弱困窘，存闕衣裳，沒無斂槥，朕甚傷之。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, an edict was issued: The way of government is not yet manifest; vulgar abuses still run deep; the extravagant merge holdings and the poor and weak are trapped in hardship; the living lack clothes and the dead lack coffins—I am deeply grieved by this.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict declared: The way of government is not yet manifest; vulgar abuses still run deep; the extravagant merge holdings and the poor and weak are trapped in hardship; the living lack clothes and the dead lack coffins—I am deeply grieved by this.

sentences.zh: 其明敕守宰，勤加存卹。

translations.literal: Let this be clearly commanded to the prefects and magistrates to be diligent in preservation and relief.
translations.idiomatic: Let this be clearly commanded to the prefects and magistrates to be diligent in preservation and relief.

sentences.zh: 賻贈之科，速為條品。

translations.literal: The regulations for funeral gifts—quickly make them into graded articles.」

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，以金紫光祿大夫褚湛之為尚書左僕射。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, the Grand Master of the Golden Bell and Purple Radiance Chu Zhanzhi was made Minister of the Left.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Grand Master of the Golden Bell and Purple Radiance Chu Zhanzhi was made Minister of the Left.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，中書監、尚書令、衞將軍建平王宏以本號開府儀同三司，中書監如故。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Supervisor of the Secretariat, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and General of the Guard Prince of Jianping Hong was given the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies with his present title, retaining the Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Supervisor of the Secretariat, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and General of the Guard Prince of Jianping Hong was given the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies with his present title, retaining the Supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，驃騎將軍柳元景以本號開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the Rapid Tiger General-in-Chief Liu Yuanjing was given the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies with his present title.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Rapid Tiger General-in-Chief Liu Yuanjing was given the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies with his present title.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，散騎常侍義陽王昶為中軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, the Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Center.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Center.

sentences.zh: 三月丁未，中書監、尚書令、衞將軍建平王宏薨。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingwei, the Supervisor of the Secretariat, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and General of the Guard Prince of Jianping Hong died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the third month, Supervisor of the Secretariat, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and General of the Guard Prince of Jianping Hong died.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以田農要月，太官停殺牛。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, because it was the critical month for agriculture, the Imperial Butcher suspended the slaughter of cattle.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, because it was the critical month for agriculture, the Imperial Butcher suspended the slaughter of cattle.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，上於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

translations.idiomatic: On guiyou General Who Pacifies the North Liu Jizhi was made Inspector of Si.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲申，立皇子子綏為安陸王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiashen, the imperial son Zisui was enfeoffed as Prince of Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the fourth month of summer, the imperial son Zisui was enfeoffed as Prince of Anlu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以海陵王休茂為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Prince of Hailing Xiumao was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Prince of Hailing Xiumao was made Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，地震。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，復西陽郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day wushen, the commandery of Xiyang was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, the commandery of Xiyang was restored.

sentences.zh: 六月戊寅，增置吏部尚書一人，省五兵尚書。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day wuyin, one additional Master of the Ministry of Personnel was appointed and the Master of the Five Arms was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuyin, one additional Master of the Ministry of Personnel was appointed and the Master of the Five Arms was abolished.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，左光祿大夫何尚之加開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness He Shangzhi was given credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness He Shangzhi received credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以金紫光祿大夫羊玄保為右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Yang Xuanbao was made Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Yang Xuanbao was made Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔曰：「往因師旅，多有逋亡。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, an edict was issued: In the past, because of military campaigns, many fled and went into hiding.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen an edict declared: In the past, because of military campaigns, many fled and went into hiding.

sentences.zh: 或連山染逆，懼致軍憲；

translations.literal: Some, dwelling in remote hills, had been touched by rebellion and feared military punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Some, dwelling in remote hills, had been touched by rebellion and feared military punishment;

sentences.zh: 或辭役憚勞，苟免刑罰。

translations.literal: some, shirking corvée and dreading toil, sought only to escape punishment.
translations.idiomatic: some shirked corvée and dreaded toil, seeking only to escape punishment.

sentences.zh: 雖約法從簡，務思弘宥，恩令驟下，而逃伏猶多。

translations.literal: Though the law was kept simple and broad mercy was intended, grace edicts were issued in rapid succession, yet those in hiding remained numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Though the law was kept simple and broad mercy was intended, grace edicts followed one after another, yet fugitives remained numerous.

sentences.zh: 豈習愚為性，忸惡難反；

translations.literal: Was it that stupidity had become their nature and shame at evil made return difficult;
translations.idiomatic: Was it that stupidity had become their nature and shame at evil made return difficult;

sentences.zh: 將在所長吏，宣導乖方。

translations.literal: or was it that the local chief officials had guided and proclaimed the policy awry.
translations.idiomatic: or was it that local chiefs had guided and proclaimed the policy awry.

sentences.zh: 可普加寬申，咸與更始。」

translations.literal: Let grace be extended broadly and all be granted a new beginning.」
translations.idiomatic: Let grace be extended broadly and all be granted a new beginning.」

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，彭城民高闍等謀反伏誅。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiachen, Gao Ge of Pengcheng and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiachen, Gao Ge of Pengcheng and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍顏師伯為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the General of the Right Guard Yan Shibo was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai General of the Right Guard Yan Shibo was made Inspector of Qing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 八月乙酉，河南王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day yiyou, the King of Henan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yiyou, the King of Henan sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，中書令王僧達有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, the Director of the Secretariat Wang Sengda, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Director of the Secretariat Wang Sengda, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以強弩將軍杜叔文為寧州刺史，交州刺史費淹為廣州刺史，南海太守垣閬為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the General of Powerful Crossbows Du Shuwen was made Inspector of Ning; the Inspector of Jiao Fei Yan was made Inspector of Guang; the Administrator of Nanhai Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou General of Powerful Crossbows Du Shuwen was made Inspector of Ning; Inspector of Jiao Fei Yan was made Inspector of Guang; Administrator of Nanhai Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Jiao.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以寧朔將軍沈僧榮為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, the General Who Pacifies the North Shen Sengrong was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu General Who Pacifies the North Shen Sengrong was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 九月癸卯，於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day guimao, cases were heard at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以寧朔將軍劉道隆為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the General Who Pacifies the North Liu Daolong was made Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu General Who Pacifies the North Liu Daolong was made Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 襄陽大水，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: Great floods struck Xiangyang; envoys were dispatched to tour the region and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck Xiangyang; envoys were sent to tour the region and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 庚午，置武衞將軍、武騎常侍官。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, the posts of General of the Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of the Martial Cavalry were established.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu the posts of General of the Martial Guard and Regular Attendant of the Martial Cavalry were established.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲午，以中軍將軍義陽王昶為江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiawu, the General of the Central Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was made Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiawu, General of the Central Army Prince of Yiyang Chang was made Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 乙未，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬子，揚州刺史西陽王子尚加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renzi, Prince of Xiyang Zishang, Inspector of Yang, was given the additional title of General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renzi, Inspector of Yang Prince of Xiyang Zishang was given the additional title of General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 十二月己亥，諸王及妃主庶姓位從公者，喪事聽設凶門，餘悉斷。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day jihai, for princes and consorts of common surname holding ranks equal to the Three Excellencies, funeral rites might set up a mourning gate; all others were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jihai, princes and consorts of common surname holding ranks equal to the Three Excellencies might set up a mourning gate for funerals; all others were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 閏月庚子，詔曰：「夫山處巖居，不以魚鼈為禮。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day gengzi, an edict was issued: Those who dwell in mountains and live in cliffs do not take fish and turtle as ritual offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengzi, an edict declared: Those who dwell in mountains and live on cliffs do not take fish and turtle as ritual offerings.

sentences.zh: 頃歲多虞，軍調繁切，違方設賦，本濟一時，而主者玩習，遂為常典。

translations.literal: In recent years there has been much trouble; military levies have been urgent and pressing. Levies imposed contrary to local custom were meant to meet a moment's need, yet those in charge have grown accustomed to them and they have become regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years there has been much trouble; military levies have been urgent. Levies contrary to local custom were meant for a moment's need, yet officials have grown accustomed to them and they have become regular practice.

sentences.zh: 杶檊瑤琨，任土作貢，積羽羣輕，終致深弊。

translations.literal: Pawlonia, catalpa, jade, and fine stone—each land should offer what it produces; yet when feathers are piled, the weight grows light, and in the end deep harm is done.
translations.idiomatic: Pawlonia, catalpa, jade, and fine stone—each land should offer what it produces; yet when trifles accumulate, deep harm follows in the end.

sentences.zh: 永言弘革，無替朕心。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of broad reform, let it not fall short of my intent.
translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of broad reform, let it not fall short of my intent.

sentences.zh: 凡寰衞貢職，山淵採捕，皆當詳辨產殖，考順歲時，勿使牽課虛懸，睽忤氣序。

translations.literal: All tribute duties of the capital region and products gathered from mountains and marshes must be examined in detail as to what each place produces and assessed according to the seasons, so that forced quotas hang empty in the air and run counter to the natural order.
translations.idiomatic: All tribute duties of the capital region and products gathered from mountains and marshes must be examined as to what each place produces and assessed by season, so that forced quotas are not imposed in vain and the natural order is not violated.

sentences.zh: 庶簡約之風，有孚於品性；

translations.literal: Thus may the wind of simplicity win trust in character;
translations.idiomatic: Thus may the wind of simplicity win trust in character;

sentences.zh: 惠敏之訓，無漏於幽仄。

translations.literal: and the teaching of grace and care leave none in remote corners neglected.」
translations.idiomatic: and the teaching of grace and care leave none in remote corners neglected.」

translations.literal: On the day renxu, the state of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Linyi sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 是冬，索虜寇青州，刺史顏師伯頻大破之。

translations.literal: That winter the northern enemy raided Qing Province; the Inspector Yan Shibo repeatedly inflicted great defeats upon them.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the northern enemy raided Qing Province; Inspector Yan Shibo repeatedly inflicted great defeats on them.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丁亥，割豫州梁郡屬徐州。

translations.literal: In the third year, in the first month of spring, on the day dinghai, Liang commandery in Yu Province was detached and placed under Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, on dinghai in the first month of spring, Liang commandery in Yu was detached and placed under Xu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以驃騎將軍、領軍將軍柳元景為尚書令，尚書右僕射劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the General Who Pacifies the Cavalry and General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Masters of Writing; the Right Vice Director Liu Zunkao was made General of the Palace Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou General Who Pacifies the Cavalry and General of the Palace Garrison Liu Yuanjing was made Director of the Masters of Writing, and Right Vice Director Liu Zunkao was made General of the Palace Garrison.

sentences.zh: 丙申，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the state of Bohuang sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Bohuang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，以揚州所統六郡為王畿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yimao, the six commanderies governed by Yang Province were made the metropolitan domain.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, the six commanderies governed by Yang were made the metropolitan domain.

sentences.zh: 以東揚州為揚州。

translations.literal: Eastern Yang Province was made Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Yang was made Yang Province.

sentences.zh: [16]時欲立司隸校尉，以元凶已立乃止。

translations.literal: Editorial note 16.
translations.idiomatic: Editorial note 16.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍、揚州刺史西陽王子尚徙為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yang Prince of Xiyang Zishang was transferred to be Inspector of Yang.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yang Prince of Xiyang Zishang was made Inspector of Yang.

sentences.zh: 甲子，復置廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the post of Supervisor of the Court of Justice was restored.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the post of Supervisor of the Court of Justice was restored.

sentences.zh: 荊州饑，三月甲申，原田租布各有差。

translations.literal: Jing Province suffered famine; in the third month, on the day jiashen, field rents and cloth taxes were remitted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Jing suffered famine; in the third month, on jiashen, field rents and cloth taxes were remitted in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以義興太守垣閬為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Administrator of Yixing Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Administrator of Yixing Yuan Lang was made Inspector of Yan.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，中護軍湘東王彧遷職，以中書令東海王褘為衞將軍、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, the General Who Protects the Army Prince of Xiangdong Yu was transferred to another post; the Director of the Secretariat Prince of Donghai Hui was made General of the Guard and General Who Protects the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen General Who Protects the Army Prince of Xiangdong Yu was reassigned; Director of the Secretariat Prince of Donghai Hui was made General of the Guard and General Who Protects the Army.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太宰江夏王義恭加中書監。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was given the additional post of Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was also made Supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸卯，上於華林園聽訟。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on guimao, the emperor heard cases at the Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以建寧太守苻仲子為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the Administrator of Jianning Fu Zhongzi was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Administrator of Jianning Fu Zhongzi was made Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，司空、南兗州刺史竟陵王誕有罪，貶爵。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Prince of Jingling Dan, having committed a crime, was degraded in rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Minister of Works and Inspector of Southern Yan Prince of Jingling Dan, having committed a crime, was degraded in rank.

sentences.zh: 誕不受命，據廣陵城反，殺兗州刺史垣閬。

translations.literal: Dan refused the command, seized Guangling city in rebellion, and killed the Inspector of Yan Yuan Lang.
translations.idiomatic: Dan refused the command, seized Guangling in rebellion, and killed Inspector of Yan Yuan Lang.

sentences.zh: 以始興公沈慶之為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史討誕。

translations.literal: The Duke of Shixing Shen Qingzhi was made Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan to suppress Dan.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Shixing Shen Qingzhi was made Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan to suppress Dan.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上親御六師，車駕出頓宣武堂。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the emperor in person commanded the six armies; the imperial carriage moved out and halted at the Hall of Martial Proclamation.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the emperor in person commanded the six armies; the imperial carriage moved out and halted at the Hall of Martial Proclamation.

sentences.zh: 司州刺史劉季之反叛，徐州刺史劉道隆討斬之。

translations.literal: The Inspector of Si Liu Jizhi rebelled; the Inspector of Xu Liu Daolong attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Inspector of Si Liu Jizhi rebelled; Inspector of Xu Liu Daolong attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己巳，剋廣陵城，斬誕。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jisi, Guangling city was taken and Dan was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jisi, Guangling was taken and Dan beheaded.

sentences.zh: 悉誅城內男丁，以女口為軍賞。

translations.literal: All males within the city were put to death; the women were taken as military reward.
translations.idiomatic: All males in the city were put to death; the women were taken as military reward.

sentences.zh: 是日解嚴。

translations.literal: That day the emergency regulations were lifted.
translations.idiomatic: That day the emergency regulations were lifted.

sentences.zh: 辛未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 尚方長徒、奚官奴婢老疾者悉原放。

translations.literal: Long-term convicts of the Imperial Workshop and aged or sick palace women and eunuch slaves were all pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: Long-term convicts of the Imperial Workshop and aged or sick palace women and eunuch slaves were all pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 孝子、順孫、義夫、節婦，賜粟帛各有差。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives were each granted grain and silk in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, righteous husbands, and chaste wives each received grain and silk in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 王畿下貧之家，與近行頓所由，並蠲租一年。

translations.literal: Poor households within the metropolitan domain and those along the route of the recent imperial halt were all exempted from rent for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Poor households in the metropolitan domain and along the route of the recent imperial halt were all exempted from rent for one year.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以丹陽尹劉秀之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the Administrator of Danyang Liu Xiuzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Administrator of Danyang Liu Xiuzhi was made Right Vice Director of the Masters of Writing.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，分淮南北復置二豫州。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, north and south of the Huai were again divided and two Yu Provinces were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu north and south of the Huai were again divided and two Yu Provinces were re-established.

sentences.zh: 以新除車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史沈慶之為司空，刺史如故。

translations.literal: The newly dismissed Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan Shen Qingzhi was made Minister of Works, his inspectorship remaining unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: The newly dismissed Grand General of the Agile Cavalry, with credentials equal to an open office with the Three Excellencies, and Inspector of Southern Yan Shen Qingzhi was made Minister of Works, retaining his inspectorship.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以衞將軍、護軍將軍東海王褘為南豫州刺史，衞將軍如故。

translations.literal: Households campaigning against the barbarians—half their rent and tax is remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Households campaigning against the barbarians—half their rent and tax is remitted.

sentences.zh: 近籍改新制，在所承用，殊謬實多，可普更符下，聽以今為始。

translations.literal: The recent household registers and the new regulations—wherever implemented, the errors have been truly many; let orders be sent broadly to revise them, and from today take this as the beginning.
translations.idiomatic: The recent household registers and the new regulations—wherever implemented, the errors have been truly many; let orders be sent broadly to revise them, and from today take this as the beginning.

sentences.zh: 若先已犯制，亦同蕩然。

translations.literal: If one has already violated the regulations, the same complete clearing applies.
translations.idiomatic: If one has already violated the regulations, the same complete clearing applies.

sentences.zh: 」甲寅，加右光祿大夫羊玄保特進。

translations.literal: 」On the day jiayin, the Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yang Xuanbao was given special advancement.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiayin Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yang Xuanbao was given special advancement.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳，改封西陽王子尚為豫章王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day guisi, the Prince of Xiyang Zishang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the fourth month of summer, Prince of Xiyang Zishang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 丙申，加尚書令柳元景左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, the Director of the Imperial Secretariat Liu Yuanjing was given the additional posts of Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commissioner with credentials equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Director of the Imperial Secretariat Liu Yuanjing was given the additional posts of Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commissioner with credentials equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔曰：「南徐、兗二州去歲水潦傷年，民多困窶。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, an edict was issued: Southern Xu and Yan provinces last year suffered flood damage to the harvest, and the people are much impoverished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu an edict declared: Southern Xu and Yan provinces last year suffered flood damage to the harvest, and the people are much impoverished.

sentences.zh: 逋租未入者，可申至秋登。

translations.literal: Unpaid rents not yet entered may be deferred until the autumn harvest is registered.
translations.idiomatic: Unpaid rents not yet entered may be deferred until the autumn harvest is registered.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，雍州刺史海陵王休茂殺司馬庾深之，舉兵反，義成太守薛繼考討斬之。

translations.literal: 」On the day bingwu, the Inspector of Yong Prince of Hailing Xiumao killed his Chief Clerk Yu Shenzhi and raised troops in rebellion; the Administrator of Yicheng Xue Jikao attacked and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: 」On bingwu Inspector of Yong Prince of Hailing Xiumao killed his Chief Clerk Yu Shenzhi and raised troops in rebellion; Administrator of Yicheng Xue Jikao attacked and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: [18]甲寅，以第九皇子子仁為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: [18] On the day jiayin, the ninth imperial son Ziren was made Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: [18] On jiayin the ninth imperial son Ziren was made Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，制帝室期親，朝官非祿官者，月給錢十萬。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day guihai, it was ordained that collateral kin of the imperial house within one degree of mourning, and court officials who were not stipendiary officers, should each month receive one hundred thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the fifth month, it was ordained that collateral kin of the imperial house within one degree of mourning, and court officials who were not stipendiary officers, should each month receive one hundred thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，車駕幸閱武堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the imperial carriage visited the Review of Arms Hall to hear cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen the emperor visited the Review of Arms Hall to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，以護軍將軍義陽王昶為中軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day bingwu, the Colonel of the Guard Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Center.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu in the sixth month, Colonel of the Guard Prince of Yiyang Chang was made General of the Center.

sentences.zh: 壬子，分廣陵置沛郡，省東平郡并廣陵。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, the Pei Commandery was established from Guangling, and the Dongping Commandery was abolished and merged into Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the Pei Commandery was established from Guangling, and the Dongping Commandery was abolished and merged into Guangling.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙辰，詔曰：「雨水猥降，街衢泛溢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day bingchen, an edict was issued: Rain has fallen in torrents and the streets and lanes are flooded.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the seventh month of autumn, an edict declared: Rain has fallen in torrents and the streets and lanes are flooded.

sentences.zh: 可遣使巡行。

translations.literal: Envoys may be sent to tour and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys may be sent to tour and inspect.

sentences.zh: 窮弊之家，賜以薪粟。

translations.literal: Destitute and exhausted households shall be given firewood and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Destitute and exhausted households shall be given firewood and grain.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: 」On the day dingmao, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingmao the state of Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 庚午，曲赦雍州。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yong province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Yong province.

sentences.zh: 八月戊子，立第九皇子子仁為永嘉王，第十一皇子子真為始安王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on the day wuzi, the ninth imperial son Ziren was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongjia and the eleventh imperial son Zizhen as Prince of Shi'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the eighth month, the ninth imperial son Ziren was enfeoffed as Prince of Yongjia and the eleventh Zizhen as Prince of Shi'an.

sentences.zh: 以北中郎參軍費伯弘為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: The Consultation Officer of the North Central Commandery Fei Bohong was made Inspector of Ning.
translations.idiomatic: Consultation Officer of the North Central Commandery Fei Bohong was made Inspector of Ning.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔曰：「自靈命初基，聖圖重遠。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, an edict was issued: From the time when the numinous Mandate was first founded, the sacred design has been far-reaching.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou an edict declared: From the time when the numinous Mandate was first founded, the sacred design has been far-reaching.

sentences.zh: 參正樂職，感神明之應；

translations.literal: Harmonizing and rectifying music duties, it moved the response of spirits and gods;
translations.idiomatic: Harmonizing and rectifying music duties, it moved the response of spirits and gods;

sentences.zh: 崇殖禮囿，奮至德之光。

translations.literal: honoring and cultivating the garden of rites, it raised the radiance of utmost virtue.
translations.idiomatic: honoring and cultivating the garden of rites, it raised the radiance of utmost virtue.

sentences.zh: 聲實同和，文以均節，化調其俗，物性其情。

translations.literal: Sound and substance joined in harmony; pattern with measure balanced them; transformation adjusted custom, and things took on their natures.
translations.idiomatic: Sound and substance joined in harmony; pattern with measure balanced them; transformation adjusted custom, and things took on their natures.

sentences.zh: 故臨經式奠，煥乎炳發，道喪世屯，學落年永。

translations.literal: Therefore, facing the classics and performing the rites of offering, brilliance blazed forth; when the Way was lost and the age beset, learning fell and years grew long.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore, facing the classics and performing the rites of offering, brilliance blazed forth; when the Way was lost and the age beset, learning fell and years grew long.

sentences.zh: 獄訟微衰息之術，百姓忘退素之方。

translations.literal: In prison litigation the arts of gradual pacification faded; among the common people they forgot the way of yielding and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: In prison litigation the arts of gradual pacification faded; among the common people they forgot the way of yielding and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 今息警夷嶂，恬波河渚，棧山航海，嚮風慕義，化民成俗，茲焉時矣。

translations.literal: Now alarms are stilled on the barbarian ridges and waves lie tranquil on the river isles; scaling mountains and sailing seas, all turn to the wind and cherish righteousness—the time to transform the people and complete custom is now.
translations.idiomatic: Now alarms are stilled on the barbarian ridges and waves lie tranquil on the river isles; scaling mountains and sailing seas, all turn to the wind and cherish righteousness—the time to transform the people and complete custom is now.

sentences.zh: [19]來歲可修葺庠序，旌延國冑。

translations.literal: [19] Next year the schools may be repaired and extended, and the heirs of the state honored.
translations.idiomatic: [19] Next year the schools may be repaired and extended, and the heirs of the state honored.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，制方鎮所假白板郡縣，年限依臺除，食祿三分之一，不給送故。

translations.literal: 」On the day gengyin, it was ordained that for white-board commanderies and counties temporarily granted by frontier posts, the term should follow metropolitan dismissal; they receive one-third of the stipend and no funeral gifts on departure.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengyin it was ordained that for white-board commanderies and counties temporarily granted by frontier posts, the term should follow metropolitan dismissal; they receive one-third of the stipend and no funeral gifts on departure.

translations.idiomatic: General of the Guard Prince of Donghai Yi was given the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies with his present title.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: On the first day of the ninth month, jiayin, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the ninth month, jiayin, there was an eclipse of the sun.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，行幸琅邪郡，囚繫悉原遣。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, the emperor traveled to Langye Commandery; all prisoners held in custody were entirely pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the emperor traveled to Langye Commandery; all prisoners held in custody were entirely pardoned and released.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，移南豫州治淮南于湖縣。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the seat of Southern Yan province was moved to Huainan, at Huxian.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the seat of Southern Yan province was moved to Huainan, at Huxian.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以冠軍將軍尋陽王子房為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou, the Champion General Prince of Xunyang Zifang was made Inspector of Southern Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Champion General Prince of Xunyang Zifang was made Inspector of Southern Yan.

sentences.zh: 閏月戊子，皇太子妃何氏薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day wuzi, the consort of the Crown Prince, the He clan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the intercalary month, the consort of the Crown Prince, of the He clan, died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，初立馳道，自閶闔門至于朱雀門，又自承明門至于玄武湖。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, for the first time the imperial speedway was established, from the Changhe Gate to the Vermilion Bird Gate, and from the Chenming Gate to the Xuanwu Lake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen the imperial speedway was first established, from the Changhe Gate to the Vermilion Bird Gate, and from the Chenming Gate to the Xuanwu Lake.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，改封歷陽王子頊為臨海王。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Prince of Liyang Zixiang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Prince of Liyang Zixiang was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Linhai.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲寅，以車騎將軍、南徐州刺史劉延孫為尚書左僕射、領護軍將軍，尚書右僕射劉秀之為安北將軍、雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiayin, the General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Liu Yansun was made Minister of the Left and Colonel of the Guard; the Minister of the Right Liu Xiuzhi was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the tenth month of winter, General of Chariots and Cavalry and Inspector of Southern Xu Liu Yansun was made Minister of the Left and Colonel of the Guard; Minister of the Right Liu Xiuzhi was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Yong.

sentences.zh: 以冠軍將軍臨海王子頊為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: The Champion General Prince of Linhai Zixiang was made Inspector of Guang.
translations.idiomatic: Champion General Prince of Linhai Zixiang was made Inspector of Guang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以東中郎將新安王子鸞為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the General of the East Center Prince of Xin'an Ziluan was made Inspector of Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao General of the East Center Prince of Xin'an Ziluan was made Inspector of Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰，詔曰：「王畿內奉京師，外表眾夏，民殷務廣，宜思簡惠。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day renchen, an edict was issued: The metropolitan commandery within serves the capital and without displays the myriad Xia—the people are numerous and affairs broad; one should think of simplicity and grace.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen in the eleventh month, an edict declared: The metropolitan commandery within serves the capital and without displays the myriad Xia—the people are numerous and affairs broad; one should think of simplicity and grace.

sentences.zh: 可遣尚書就加詳檢，并與守宰平治庶獄。

translations.literal: The Masters of Writing may be sent to add detailed inspection, and together with the prefects and magistrates settle the common prisons.
translations.idiomatic: The Masters of Writing may be sent to add detailed inspection, and together with the prefects and magistrates settle the common prisons.

sentences.zh: 其有疑滯，具以狀聞。

translations.literal: Where there are doubts or delays, let full reports be submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Where there are doubts or delays, let full reports be submitted.

sentences.zh: 」丁酉，增置少府丞一人。

translations.literal: 」On the day dingyou, one additional Assistant Director of the Imperial Household was added.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingyou one additional Assistant Director of the Imperial Household was added.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申，以領軍將軍劉遵考為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the day renshen, the Colonel of the Garrison Liu Zunkao was made Minister of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the twelfth month, Colonel of the Garrison Liu Zunkao was made Minister of the Right.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，制天下民戶歲輸布四疋。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, it was ordained that households throughout the empire should each year deliver four bolts of cloth.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu it was ordained that households throughout the empire should each year deliver four bolts of cloth.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以太常王玄謨為平北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, the Minister of Ceremonies Wang Xuanmo was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Minister of Ceremonies Wang Xuanmo was made General Who Pacifies the North and Inspector of Xu.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月己丑，湘州刺史建安王休仁加平南將軍。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, on the day jichou, the Inspector of Xiang Prince of Jian'an Xiuren was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the South.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the first month of the sixth year, Inspector of Xiang Prince of Jian'an Xiuren was given the additional title General Who Pacifies the South.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the imperial carriage in person sacrificed at the Southern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao the emperor sacrificed at the Southern Suburb in person.

sentences.zh: 是日，又宗祀明堂。

translations.literal: That same day, the Bright Hall was also honored with sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: That same day, the Bright Hall was also honored with sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the empire.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 孝子、順孫、義夫、悌弟，賜爵一級，慈姑、節婦及孤老、六疾，賜帛五匹，穀十斛。

translations.literal: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of righteousness, and respectful younger brothers were each granted one rank of nobility; kindly mothers-in-law, chaste wives, and the orphaned, aged, and six kinds of infirm were each given five bolts of silk and ten hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Filial sons, obedient grandsons, men of righteousness, and respectful younger brothers were each granted one rank of nobility; kindly mothers-in-law, chaste wives, and the orphaned, aged, and six kinds of infirm were each given five bolts of silk and ten hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 下四方旌賞茂異，其有懷真抱素，志行清白，恬退自守，不交當世，或識通古今，才經軍國，奉公廉直，高譽在民，具以名奏。

translations.literal: Throughout the four quarters, banners were raised to reward outstanding excellence; those who harbor truth and embrace simplicity, whose conduct is pure and clear, who retire in quiet and keep to themselves without mixing with the age, or who know past and present and possess talent for state and army, who serve the public with integrity and whose lofty reputation is among the people—let all be reported by name.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout the four quarters, banners were raised to reward outstanding excellence; those who harbor truth and embrace simplicity, whose conduct is pure and clear, who retire in quiet without mixing with the age, or who know past and present and possess talent for state and army, who serve the public with integrity and whose lofty reputation is among the people—let all be reported by name.

sentences.zh: 乙未，置五官中郎將、左右中郎將官。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the posts of Colonel of the Five Offices and Colonel of the Left and Right Offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the posts of Colonel of the Five Offices and Colonel of the Left and Right Offices were established.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，復百官祿。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day yimao, the stipends of the hundred offices were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the second month, the stipends of the hundred offices were restored.

sentences.zh: 三月庚寅，立第十三皇子子元為邵陵王。

translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the third month, the thirteenth imperial son Ziyuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Shaoling.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，以倭國王世子興為安東將軍。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the heir of the King of Wa, Xing, was made General Who Guards the East.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the heir of the King of Wa, Xing, was made General Who Guards the East.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，改豫州南梁郡為淮南郡，舊淮南郡并宣城。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, the Southern Liang Commandery of Yu was changed to the Huainan Commandery, and the old Huainan Commandery was merged into Xuancheng.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Southern Liang Commandery of Yu was changed to the Huainan Commandery, and the old Huainan Commandery was merged into Xuancheng.

sentences.zh: 丁未，輔國將軍、征虜長史、廣陵太守沈懷文有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, the Assisting State General, Chief Clerk of the General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, and Administrator of Guangling Shen Huaiwen, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Assisting State General, Chief Clerk of the General Who Pacifies the Barbarians, and Administrator of Guangling Shen Huaiwen, having committed a crime, was imprisoned and died.

sentences.zh: 四月庚申，原除南兗州大明三年以前逋租。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, on the day gengshen, unpaid rents of Southern Yan before the third year of Daming were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the fourth month, unpaid rents of Southern Yan before the third year of Daming were remitted.

sentences.zh: 新作大航門。

translations.literal: The Great Floating Gate was newly built.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Floating Gate was newly built.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌，置凌室，修藏冰之禮。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on the day bingxu, the Ice Chamber was established and the rites of storing ice were restored.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the fifth month, the Ice Chamber was established and the rites of storing ice were restored.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，太宰江夏王義恭解領司徒。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong relinquished charge of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Grand Preceptor Prince of Jiangxia Yigong relinquished charge of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 六月辛酉，尚書左僕射、護軍將軍劉延孫卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day xinyou, the Minister of the Left and Colonel of the Guard Liu Yansun died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou in the sixth month, Minister of the Left and Colonel of the Guard Liu Yansun died.

translations.idiomatic: [20] Editorial note twenty stands in the received text at this point in the narrative.

translations.idiomatic: On gengchen in the seventh month of autumn, Inspector of Jing Zhu Xiuzhi was made Colonel of the Garrison; Inspector of Guang Prince of Linhai Zixiang was made Inspector of Jing.

translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Assisting State General Wang Yizhi was made Inspector of Guang.

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the Administrator of Xiyang Tan Yizhi was made Inspector of Jiao.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Administrator of Xiyang Tan Yizhi was made Inspector of Jiao.

translations.idiomatic: On yiwei the nineteenth imperial son Ziyun was enfeoffed as Prince of Jinling.

translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the eighth month, unpaid rents of Yong before the fourth year of Daming were remitted.

translations.literal: On the day yihai, the Director of the Pure Terrace was established.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the Director of the Pure Terrace was established.

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on the day wuyin, it was ordained that Buddhist monks should pay obeisance to the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin in the ninth month, it was ordained that Buddhist monks should pay obeisance to the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以前金紫光祿大夫宗慤為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, the former Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Zong Que was made Colonel of the Central Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi former Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal Zong Que was made Colonel of the Central Guard.

sentences.zh: 乙未，尚書右僕射劉遵考為尚書左僕射，丹陽尹王僧朗為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei, the Minister of the Right Liu Zunkao was made Minister of the Left, and the Administrator of Danyang Wang Senglang was made Minister of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Minister of the Right Liu Zunkao was made Minister of the Left, and Administrator of Danyang Wang Senglang was made Minister of the Right.

sentences.zh: 冬十月丁巳，以山陽王休祐子士弘繼鄱陽哀王休業。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day dingsi, the son of Prince of Shanyang Xiuyou, Shihong, succeeded as the lamented Prince of Poyang Xiye.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the tenth month of winter, the son of Prince of Shanyang Xiuyou, Shihong, succeeded as the lamented Prince of Poyang Xiye.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，詔上林苑內民庶丘墓欲還合葬者，[21]勿禁。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, an edict declared: Within the Shanglin Park, commoners who wished to return ancestral tombs for joint burial, [21] were not forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao an edict declared: Within the Shanglin Park, commoners who wished to return ancestral tombs for joint burial [21] were not forbidden.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸未，詔曰：「春蒐之禮，著自周令；

translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the first month of the seventh year, an edict declared: The spring hunt rite is set forth in the Zhou ordinances;

sentences.zh: 講事之語，書于魯史。

translations.literal: the words on drilling troops are recorded in the Lu history.
translations.idiomatic: the words on drilling troops are recorded in the Lu history.

sentences.zh: 所以昭宣德度，示民軌則。

translations.literal: By them virtue and measure are displayed to the people and rules shown.
translations.idiomatic: By them virtue and measure are displayed to the people and rules shown.

sentences.zh: 今歲稔氣榮，中外寧晏。

translations.literal: This year the harvest is abundant and the air is flourishing; within and without are tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: This year the harvest is abundant and the air is flourishing; within and without are tranquil.

sentences.zh: 當因農隙，葺是舊章。

translations.literal: At the agricultural interval, the old regulations should be restored.
translations.idiomatic: At the agricultural interval, the old regulations should be restored.

sentences.zh: 可克日於玄武湖大閱水師，并巡江右，講武校獵。

translations.literal: On a set day a great review of the naval forces may be held at the Xuanwu Lake, and the right bank of the Yangzi toured, with military drill and hunting.
translations.idiomatic: On a set day a great review of the naval forces may be held at the Xuanwu Lake, and the right bank of the Yangzi toured, with military drill and hunting.

translations.idiomatic: 」On dinghai Minister of the Right Wang Senglang was made Minister of Ceremonies, and General of the Guard Yan Shibo was made Minister of the Right.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以尚書令柳元景為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, the Director of the Imperial Secretariat Liu Yuanjing was made Rapid Tiger General-in-Chief with the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Director of the Imperial Secretariat Liu Yuanjing was made Rapid Tiger General-in-Chief with the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以南兗州刺史晉安王子勛為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the Inspector of Southern Yan Prince of Jin'an Zixun was made Inspector of Jiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Inspector of Southern Yan Prince of Jin'an Zixun was made Inspector of Jiang.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，割吳郡屬南徐州。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Wu Commandery was detached and placed under Southern Xu.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Wu Commandery was detached and placed under Southern Xu.

sentences.zh: 二月甲寅，車駕巡南豫、南兗二州。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jiayin, the imperial carriage toured Southern Yu and Southern Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the second month, the emperor toured Southern Yu and Southern Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「江漢楚望，咸秩周禋，禮九疑於盛唐，祀蓬萊於渤海，皆前載流訓，列聖遺式。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict was issued: The Yangtze and Han, Chu and its outlook—all are ranked in the Zhou sacrifices; the rites honor Jiuyi in prosperous Tang and sacrifice Penglai in Bohai—all are teachings handed down by former records and models left by successive sages.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict declared: The Yangtze and Han, Chu and its outlook—all are ranked in the Zhou sacrifices; the rites honor Jiuyi in prosperous Tang and sacrifice Penglai in Bohai—all are teachings handed down by former records and models left by successive sages.

sentences.zh: 霍山是曰南嶽，實維國鎮，韞靈呈瑞，肇光宋道。

translations.literal: Mount Huo is called the Southern Peak and is truly a pillar of the state; its hidden spirit manifests omens and first lit the Song Way.
translations.idiomatic: Mount Huo is called the Southern Peak and is truly a pillar of the state; its hidden spirit manifests omens and first lit the Song Way.

sentences.zh: 朕駐驆于野，有事岐陽，瞻睇風雲，徘徊以想。

translations.literal: I halt my chariot in the wilds and have affairs at Qiyang; gazing at wind and cloud, I linger in thought.
translations.idiomatic: I halt my chariot in the wilds and have affairs at Qiyang; gazing at wind and cloud, I linger in thought.

sentences.zh: 可遣使奠祭。

translations.literal: Envoys may be sent to perform the offering sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys may be sent to perform the offering sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，車駕校獵于歷陽之烏江。

translations.literal: 」On the day dingsi, the imperial carriage conducted a hunt review at Wujiang in Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: 」On dingsi the emperor conducted a hunt review at Wujiang in Liyang.

sentences.zh: 己未，車駕登烏江縣六合山。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, the imperial carriage ascended the Liuhe Mountain in Wujiang county.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei the emperor ascended the Liuhe Mountain in Wujiang county.

sentences.zh: 庚申，割歷陽秦郡置臨江郡。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, the Qin Commandery of Liyang was detached to establish the Linjiang Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the Qin Commandery of Liyang was detached to establish the Linjiang Commandery.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，[22]詔曰：「朕受天慶命，十一年於茲矣。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, [22] an edict was issued: I have received Heaven’s felicitous Mandate for eleven years now.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, [22] an edict declared: I have received Heaven’s felicitous Mandate for eleven years now.

sentences.zh: 憑七廟之靈，獲上帝之力，禮橫四海，威震八荒。

translations.literal: Relying on the spirits of the seven temples and gaining the strength of the Supreme Lord, rites extend across the four seas and awe shakes the eight wilds.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on the spirits of the seven temples and gaining the strength of the Supreme Lord, rites extend across the four seas and awe shakes the eight wilds.

sentences.zh: 方巡三湘而奠衡嶽，次九河而檢云、岱。

translations.literal: I am about to tour the three Xiang and offer at Mount Heng, then proceed to the nine rivers and inspect Yun and Dai.
translations.idiomatic: I am about to tour the three Xiang and offer at Mount Heng, then proceed to the nine rivers and inspect Yun and Dai.

sentences.zh: 今恢覽功成，省風畿表，觀民六合，蒐校長洲。

translations.literal: Now, with achievements broadly surveyed, I inspect the winds of the metropolitan region, observe the people of the six harmonies, and hunt review on the long isle.
translations.idiomatic: Now, with achievements broadly surveyed, I inspect the winds of the metropolitan region, observe the people of the six harmonies, and hunt review on the long isle.

sentences.zh: 騰沙飛礫，平嶽盪海，鼖晉合序，鐃鉦協節，獻鬯如禮，饁獸傾郊，敬舉王公之觴，廣納士民之壽。

translations.literal: Sand flies and stones scatter, leveling mountains and churning seas; drums and bells keep order, gongs and cymbals match the beat; fragrant spirits are offered as in ritual, roasted beasts fill the suburbs; the toast of kings and dukes is raised and the longevity of knights and commoners is broadly received.
translations.idiomatic: Sand flies and stones scatter, leveling mountains and churning seas; drums and bells keep order, gongs and cymbals match the beat; fragrant spirits are offered as in ritual, roasted beasts fill the suburbs; the toast of kings and dukes is raised and the longevity of knights and commoners is broadly received.

sentences.zh: 八風循通，卿雲叢聚，盡天罄瑞，率宇竭歡。

translations.literal: The eight winds circulate in harmony; auspicious clouds gather in clusters; omens exhaust heaven and rejoicing fills the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The eight winds circulate in harmony; auspicious clouds gather in clusters; omens exhaust heaven and rejoicing fills the realm.

sentences.zh: 思散太極之泉，以福無方之外。

translations.literal: I think to spread the fountain of the Great Ultimate to bless what lies beyond all bounds.
translations.idiomatic: I think to spread the fountain of the Great Ultimate to bless what lies beyond all bounds.

sentences.zh: 可大赦天下，行幸所經，無出今歲租布。

translations.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed throughout the empire; wherever the imperial progress passes, no rent or cloth shall be levied this year.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty may be proclaimed; wherever the imperial progress passes, no rent or cloth shall be levied this year.

sentences.zh: 其逋租餘債，勿復收。

translations.literal: Unpaid rents and remaining debts shall not again be collected.
translations.idiomatic: Unpaid rents and remaining debts shall not again be collected.

sentences.zh: 賜民爵一級，女子百戶牛酒。

translations.literal: The people are granted one rank of nobility; each hundred households receive oxen and wine.
translations.idiomatic: The people are granted one rank of nobility; each hundred households receive oxen and wine.

sentences.zh: 刺守邑宰及民夫從蒐者，普加沾賚。

translations.literal: Inspectors, magistrates, and corvée laborers who followed the hunt shall all share in the bounty.
translations.idiomatic: Inspectors, magistrates, and corvée laborers who followed the hunt shall all share in the bounty.

sentences.zh: 」[23]又詔曰：「朕弱年操製，出牧司雍，承政宣風，荐歷年紀。

translations.idiomatic: 」[23] Another edict declared: In my youth I held the reins of government and went out to shepherd Si and Yong; carrying out policy and spreading influence, years have piled up.

sentences.zh: 國步中阻，治戎江甸，難夷情義，實繫于懷。

translations.literal: The state’s step was midway obstructed; I governed arms on the Yangzi reaches—hardships and righteous feeling truly lay in my breast.
translations.idiomatic: The state’s step was midway obstructed; I governed arms on the Yangzi reaches—hardships and righteous feeling truly lay in my breast.

sentences.zh: 今或練蒐訓旅，涉茲境閭，故邑耆舊，在目罕存。

translations.literal: Now, drilling troops in the hunt review, I cross these border hamlets; the old elders of my former district—few remain before my eyes.
translations.idiomatic: Now, drilling troops in the hunt review, I cross these border hamlets; the old elders of my former district—few remain before my eyes.

sentences.zh: 年世未遠，殲亡太半，撫迹惟事，傾慨兼著。

translations.literal: The years are not yet far, yet more than half have perished; tracing the traces, I am moved to sorrow and sighing together.
translations.idiomatic: The years are not yet far, yet more than half have perished; tracing the traces, I am moved to sorrow and sighing together.

sentences.zh: 太宗燕故，晉陽洽恩；

translations.literal: Emperor Taizong treated old friends with kindness; Jinyang received his grace;
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Taizong treated old friends with kindness; Jinyang received his grace;

sentences.zh: 世祖流仁，濟畿暢澤。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizu spread benevolence and the capital region enjoyed his bounty.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizu spread benevolence and the capital region enjoyed his bounty.

sentences.zh: 永言往猷，思廣前賚。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of former examples, I wish to extend the rewards of the past.
translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of former examples, I wish to extend the rewards of the past.

sentences.zh: 可蠲歷陽郡租輸三年。

translations.literal: The rent and tribute of Liyang Commandery may be remitted for three years.
translations.idiomatic: The rent and tribute of Liyang Commandery may be remitted for three years.

sentences.zh: 遣使巡慰，問民疾苦，鰥寡、孤老、六疾不能自存者，厚賜粟帛。

translations.literal: Envoys may be sent to tour and comfort, inquiring into the people’s hardships; the widowed, orphaned, aged, and six kinds of infirm who cannot support themselves shall richly receive grain and cloth.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys may be sent to tour and comfort, inquiring into the people’s hardships; the widowed, orphaned, aged, and six kinds of infirm who cannot support themselves shall richly receive grain and cloth.

sentences.zh: 高年加以羊酒。

translations.literal: The aged shall in addition receive sheep and wine.
translations.idiomatic: The aged shall in addition receive sheep and wine.

sentences.zh: 凡一介之善，隨才銓貫；

translations.literal: Every least good deed, according to talent, shall be ranked and rewarded;
translations.idiomatic: Every least good deed, according to talent, shall be ranked and rewarded;

sentences.zh: 前國名臣及府州佐吏，量所沾錫。

translations.literal: former famous ministers of the state and staff officers of prefectures and provinces shall be favored according to measure.
translations.idiomatic: former famous ministers of the state and staff officers of prefectures and provinces shall be favored according to measure.

sentences.zh: 人身已往，施及子孫。

translations.literal: Though the person is gone, the benefit extends to sons and grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: Though the person is gone, the benefit extends to sons and grandsons.

translations.literal: 」On the day renshen, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: 」On renshen the emperor returned to the palace.

translations.idiomatic: On jiayin in the fourth month of summer, Colonel of the Garrison Zhu Xiuzhi was given special advancement.

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, the Master of Writing Prince of Xiangdong Yu was made Colonel of the Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Master of Writing Prince of Xiangdong Yu was made Colonel of the Garrison.

translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict declared: Except when facing the enemy in battle array, killing on one’s own authority is everywhere forbidden.

sentences.zh: 其罪甚重辟者，[24]皆如舊先上須報，有司嚴加聽察。

translations.literal: Those whose crimes merit the heaviest punishments, [24] shall as before first be reported upward for approval; the offices must strictly oversee and inspect.

translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict declared: From now on, whenever inspectors and magistrates move the people or raise armies, all must be carried out by imperial edict in hand.

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiachen, the Chief Clerk of the North Central Commandery Liu Yuanhu was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the sixth month, Chief Clerk of the North Central Commandery Liu Yuanhu was made Inspector of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 戊申，芮芮國、高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, the states of Rouran and Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the states of Rouran and Goguryeo sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以秦郡太守劉德願為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, the Administrator of Qin Liu Deyuan was made Inspector of Yu.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Administrator of Qin Liu Deyuan was made Inspector of Yu.

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the day yihai, the General Who Guards the East and King of Goguryeo Gao Lian was advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry with the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the seventh month, General Who Guards the East and King of Goguryeo Gao Lian was advanced to General of Chariots and Cavalry with the ceremonial establishment of the Three Excellencies.

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, [25] an edict was issued: The former edict declared that river, sea, field, and pond should share profit with the people.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen, [25] an edict declared: The former edict declared that river, sea, field, and pond should share profit with the people.

sentences.zh: 歷歲未久，浸以弛替。

translations.literal: Years are not yet many, yet neglect has gradually spread.
translations.idiomatic: Years are not yet many, yet neglect has gradually spread.

sentences.zh: 名山大川，往往占固。

translations.literal: Famous mountains and great rivers are often seized and held fast.
translations.idiomatic: Famous mountains and great rivers are often seized and held fast.
